is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1, abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (1014F) and Ace-1 G280S (119S) (page 3, section 'Anopheles gambiae s.l. identification and characterisation of insecticide resistance').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 and text on page 5 provide genotype counts for the kdr allele (n=98 homozygote, n=2 heterozygote).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Yaoundé, Cameroon (page 2, 'Mosquito colonies').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original research article reporting new experimental hut and bioassay data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Yaoundé, Cameroon (page 2, 'Mosquito colonies').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field collections were conducted in December 2017 (page 2, 'Mosquito colonies').

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific new experimental hut trial conducted in 2017-2018.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of PermaNet 2.0 LLINs against a multi-resistant Anopheles coluzzii population in Yaoundé, Cameroon. It included WHO tube bioassays, cone tests, and experimental hut trials, alongside molecular characterization of kdr (L1014F) and Ace-1 (G119S) mutations and gene expression analysis.
